description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded firearm.

Duration constant

You gain resistance to all physical damage equal to half your level against attacks made by adjacent creatures, and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you is off-guard against your next Strike. If you Stride more than 10 feet in a turn, you lose both until the start of your next turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: The flat half-level physical Resistance clause matches a real pf2e shape (Resistance with a level-based formula value, precedented by Barbarian's Scars of Steel, pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/barbarian/level-4/scars-of-steel.json: "floor(@actor.level/2)+@actor.abilities.con.mod"), but this card's own text restricts it to "against attacks from adjacent creatures" specifically, and no predicate anywhere in pf2e-source scopes a Resistance rule element to "the attacker is adjacent to the defender" (checked exhaustively, same search as the [COVER] and adjacency checks run elsewhere in this class). Building it unconditionally would misrepresent the card as blanket physical resistance rather than the narrower adjacency-gated version it actually is, so it is not built. The "any creature ending its turn adjacent to you is off-guard against your next Strike" clause is separately unbuildable: it imposes a condition on a different creature from the actor's own passive, with no companion Effect item here to carry it.
